documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported FY19 reported revenue growth of 3% and consolidated like-to-like adjusted growth of 13%, driven by strong expansion in international business which grew 54%. The domestic business experienced weakness in Q4 FY19 due to an extended winter, but domestic revenues recovered with 10% YoY growth in Q1 FY20. Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points in FY19 owing to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and higher realizations in international markets. For FY20, management expects double-digit growth and margin expansion, supported by ongoing international demand and planned capex of Rs. 30-35 crore.

guidance.claim: Vadilal Industries expects to deliver double-digit growth with higher international contributions leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Vadilal Industries expects another good year in FY20 as it leverages the brand for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Continued focus on developing the domestic business and lower input costs are expected to drive growth.
guidance.quote: Continued focus on developing domestic business and lower input costs expected to drive growth

guidance.claim: Vadilal maintains a positive business outlook driven by an improving consumption environment, shift to the organized sector, and international business traction.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

guidance.claim: Management expects raw material prices to stay subdued for the next season, which should benefit margins.
guidance.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

guidance.claim: The company expects continued traction in international markets from consumers looking for distinctly Indian products.
guidance.quote: We have already invested in marketing and distribution reach and expect to see continued traction from consumers looking for distinctly Indian products backed by a strong brand.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic ice cream consumption was impacted in Q4 FY19 due to severe weather extending the winter season.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from the Indian diaspora community in the US and other key regions drove international revenues beyond $20 million.
demand_outlook.quote: International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: Vadilal started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: In Q3 FY19, Vadilal Industries delivered ~27% growth in revenues, including 12% domestic growth and 71% international growth.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q3, we have delivered ~27% growth in revenues – including 12% growth in the domestic business and 71% growth in the international business that continues to expand rapidly from a low base.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic business performance was driven by higher volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business was driven by higher volumes

demand_outlook.claim: Ice cream volumes expanded by 6.9% in Q2, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues contributed 32% to turnover during Q2 on positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other markets.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for Indian products is driving volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects regular capital expenditure of Rs. 30-35 crore during FY20.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capital expenditure for FY19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points in FY19 due to volume growth, lower raw material prices, and higher export realizations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Management has visibility of stable input costs covered until Q2 based on current purchase and inventory positions.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Higher current milk prices will prompt management to look at increasing product prices in the second half of the year.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin grew by nearly 400 basis points in FY19 alongside a doubling of profit after tax.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 gross margin expanded to 50% compared to 40% in Q3 FY18.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season have been closed, providing clear visibility on input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion was achieved through volume growth using existing capacities, lower raw material prices, and cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: This is in line with the recent trend of expansion and has been achieved through volume growth by utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices and operating cost discipline.

margins_costs.claim: Higher realizations and contribution margins from international ice cream sales are supporting profit expansion.
margins_costs.quote: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, which is also helping improve profits while increasing utilization of current capacities.

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal expanded its production capacity from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over recent years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: The Bareilly facility in Uttar Pradesh has an ice cream production capacity of 150,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005

orders_capacity.claim: The Pundhra facility in Gujarat has an ice cream production capacity of 230,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

orders_capacity.claim: The Dharampur facility in Gujarat has a processed foods capacity of 33,000 kgs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Dharampur, Gujarat 33,000 kgs per day Processed foods ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

orders_capacity.claim: Current production utilizes automated processes untouched by hand, with manual intervention only at packaging.
orders_capacity.quote: Current production on automated processes “untouched by hand”, manual intervention only at packaging stage

capital_allocation.claim: Vadilal reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long-tenure loans and reduce borrowing costs.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash surpluses will be utilized to restructure debt and enhance working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

capital_allocation.claim: Cash accretion and working capital improvements are enabling ongoing debt rationalization.
capital_allocation.quote: However, cash accretion from the business and improvements in working capital allow us to continue debt rationalization as per plan and interest expenses have been decreasing accordingly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Unusually severe weather conditions extending winter until late March affected domestic ice cream consumption in Q4 FY19.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Milk prices are currently operating at elevated levels.
risks_headwinds.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic growth faced temporary impacts from changes in the operating environment and consumption spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal expects double-digit growth with margin expansion driven by higher international sales.
management_commitments.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal plans to incur Rs. 30-35 crore in capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management will look to increase prices in the second half of the year due to elevated milk prices.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal Industries foresees another good year in FY20 leveraging its brand for growth.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

management_commitments.claim: Estimated capital expenditure for FY19 is around Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
